evidence.original_label: 晶圆混合键合设备 产品特性及优势｜面向 8/12 英寸晶圆混合键合工艺
evidence.excerpt: 公司各主要晶圆键合设备产品系列的特性及商业化情况具体如下：｜产品系列 产品特性及优势 主要应用领域 商业化阶段｜晶圆混合键合设备：面向 8/12 英寸晶圆混合键合工艺，可在常温常压下通过 Mark 对准标记实现（已经过等离子活化与清洗）两片有图形晶圆的介质与介质以及金属与金属的高精度对准预键合，低温退火后获得高精度、高强度的键合界面。｜主要应用领域：3D-NAND、DRAM、HBM、高端 CIS、Micro LED 等半导体制造及先进封装｜商业化阶段：客户验证阶段

notes: Issuer product-series capability table, physical pp109-111. The 晶圆混合键合设备 series is the issuer's wafer-to-wafer hybrid bonder (p110: 两片有图形晶圆 — two patterned wafers), separate from its 芯片-晶圆混合键合设备 (die-to-wafer, p110-111), 晶圆熔融键合设备, 晶圆热压键合设备 and 晶圆 SOI/POI 键合设备 series. Capability spec only: not a shipment, acceptance, revenue or installed-tool claim, and no allocation of the aggregate 晶圆键合设备 basket (p165 volumes, p233 revenue) to this series. Period is the prospectus reporting window's closing year; the prospectus signing date is blank in this filing. The source enumerates 8 and 12 英寸 discretely (8/12 英寸); recorded as the stated diameter span, and no intermediate diameter is asserted. The filing states the discrete sizes 8/12 英寸, not a span, so each stated diameter is a separate row. Collapsing them into a range would assert a continuous interval the source does not print.

evidence.excerpt: 产品 关键性能参数 公司产品 行业标杆产品｜晶圆混合键合设备 产品型号 UP HB UMA® / EVG GEMINI® FB｜键合残差 50nm@R147 / 50nm@R147｜产率 40WPH / 40WPH｜外部认证 晶圆混合键合设备纳入《北京市 2025 年第二批首台（套）重大技术装备目录（半导体领域）》

notes: Issuer benchmark table against 行业标杆产品, physical pp159-160. The table straddles the page break: the 产品型号 UP HB UMA® / EVG GEMINI® FB and 对准精度 / 键合精度 cells print on p159, and the 键合残差, 产率 and 外部认证 cells on p160; this row is cited to p160, the page that prints 产率 40WPH. WPH is defined in the p19 glossary as wafer per hour (每小时出片数量), so the unit is wafers per hour, not units per hour. Named-model tool capability, not a customer line measurement, shipment count or revenue basis. evidence.original_label: 晶圆熔融键合设备 产品特性及优势｜面向 12 英寸晶圆熔融键合工艺
evidence.excerpt: 产品系列 产品特性及优势 主要应用领域 商业化阶段｜晶圆熔融键合设备：面向 12 英寸晶圆熔融键合工艺，可在常温常压下通过边缘对准标记实现（已经过等离子活化与清洗）一片有图形晶圆与一片无图形晶圆的亲水性键合。公司紧跟产业应用需求，突破并应用了包括超平卡盘、超低应力键合启动装置、键合波检测与控制、氦气吹扫等多项创新核心部件与关键技术，实现纳米级超低畸变，达到国际同类设备水平。｜主要应用领域：HBM、背面供电（BSPDN）、CFET 等先进封装与先进制程应用｜商业化阶段：客户验证阶段

notes: Issuer product-series capability table, physical pp109-111. The 晶圆混合键合设备 series is the issuer's wafer-to-wafer hybrid bonder (p110: 两片有图形晶圆 — two patterned wafers), separate from its 芯片-晶圆混合键合设备 (die-to-wafer, p110-111), 晶圆熔融键合设备, 晶圆热压键合设备 and 晶圆 SOI/POI 键合设备 series. Capability spec only: not a shipment, acceptance, revenue or installed-tool claim, and no allocation of the aggregate 晶圆键合设备 basket (p165 volumes, p233 revenue) to this series. Period is the prospectus reporting window's closing year; the prospectus signing date is blank in this filing. A single stated diameter, recorded with relation eq rather than as a span. The issuer's fusion bonder bonds one patterned to one unpatterned wafer hydrophilically; it is a separate product series from the 晶圆 SOI/POI 键合设备 series, which also performs hydrophilic bonding.
